name: Poisoned Lock
disable: DC 17 Thievery check (trained) on the spring mechanism

items.name: Spring
items.text:
Trigger A creature tries to unlock or Pick the Lock.

---

Effect A spine extends to Strike the triggering creature.

items.name: Cladis Poison
items.text:
Saving Throw DC 19 Fortitude save

Maximum Duration 4 hours

Stage 1 1d6 poison damage and Drained 1 (1 hour)

Stage 2 2d6 poison damage and Drained 2 (1 hour)

Stage 3 3d6 poison damage and drained 2 (1 hour)

text: A spring-loaded, poisoned spine is hidden near the keyhole of a lock. Disabling or breaking the trap does not disable or break the lock.
